alt.en: An engraved title page in ornate lettering on worn paper: "à Mlle Emily Laurey", "Cantique de Noël (Weihnachts-Gesang)", "Paroles de M. Pde Cappeau de Roquemaure", "Übertragen von M. G. Friedrich", "mis en musique par Adolphe Adam", with the publisher's addresses in Mainz, Brussels and London at the foot and handwritten numbers and notes in ink.
alt.es: Portada grabada con letras adornadas sobre papel gastado: "à Mlle Emily Laurey", "Cantique de Noël (Weihnachts-Gesang)", "Paroles de M. Pde Cappeau de Roquemaure", "Übertragen von M. G. Friedrich", "mis en musique par Adolphe Adam", con las direcciones del editor en Maguncia, Bruselas y Londres al pie y números y notas escritos a mano con tinta.

caption.en: The cover of Schott's edition of Adam's Cantique de Noël (Mainz, Brussels and London, about 1852), dedicated to Emily Laurey, with the French words of "M. Pde Cappeau de Roquemaure" and a German version, Weihnachts-Gesang.
caption.es: La portada de la edición de Schott del Cantique de Noël de Adam (Maguncia, Bruselas y Londres, hacia 1852), dedicada a Emily Laurey, con la letra francesa de "M. Pde Cappeau de Roquemaure" y una versión alemana, Weihnachts-Gesang.

source: Adolphe Adam, Cantique de Noël: avec accompt. d'orgue-mélodium ad libitum: à M.lle Emily Laurey = Weihnachts-Gesang, L'Aurore No. 125 (Mainz: les fils de B. Schott; Brussels: Schott frères; London: Schott et Cie, [1852?]), title page
licenceEvidence: The holder's own IIIF manifest (https://api.digitale-sammlungen.de/iiif/presentation/v3/bsb00149248/manifest) gives "rights": "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/". Printed about 1852; Adam died 1856, Cappeau 1877, the German translator Gredy 1864 (see rights.md).

alt.en: A printed page of music numbered 42, headed "Cantique de Noël" and "Adolphe Adam", marked "Andante maestoso", with a voice part over piano in three systems. Three verses are stacked under the notes, beginning "O holy night", "Led by the light" and "Truly he taught us", and the third reaches "Chains shall he".
alt.es: Página impresa de música con el número 42 y el encabezado "Cantique de Noël" y "Adolphe Adam", con la indicación "Andante maestoso" y una voz sobre el piano en tres sistemas. Bajo las notas van tres estrofas, una debajo de otra, que empiezan "O holy night", "Led by the light" y "Truly he taught us", y la tercera llega a "Chains shall he".

caption.en: O Holy Night in Hollis Dann's Christmas Carols and Hymns for School and Choir (New York, 1910), page 42, the carol's first page, with all three of Dwight's verses; the third, "Truly he taught us", goes on over the page to "Chains shall he break, for the slave is our brother".
caption.es: O Holy Night en Christmas Carols and Hymns for School and Choir de Hollis Dann (Nueva York, 1910), página 42, la primera del villancico, con las tres estrofas de Dwight; la tercera, "Truly he taught us", sigue en la página siguiente hasta el verso "Chains shall he break, for the slave is our brother", romperá las cadenas, porque el esclavo es nuestro hermano.

source: Hollis Dann (ed.), Christmas Carols and Hymns for School and Choir (New York: American Book Company, 1910), No. 42, "Cantique de Noël", p. 42
library: Princeton Theological Seminary Library (digitized by the Internet Archive)
licenceEvidence: Published New York 1910; Hollis Dann 1861-1939 (Internet Archive record), John Sullivan Dwight died 1893, Adam 1856. Faithful scan of a flat page (see rights.md).
credit: Princeton Theological Seminary Library, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A printed page of music headed "Carol 741." and "O holy night. (Noël)", "Words by J. S. Dwight", "Adolph Adam", "Soprano or Tenor Solo, or Alternately", with a voice part over an organ part, marked "Sw." and "Ped.", of flowing triplet figures in four systems, the first two verses under the notes, and page number 617 at the foot.
alt.es: Página impresa de música con el encabezado "Carol 741." y "O holy night. (Noël)", "Words by J. S. Dwight", "Adolph Adam", "Soprano or Tenor Solo, or Alternately", con una voz sobre una parte de órgano, marcada "Sw." y "Ped.", de figuras de tresillos en cuatro sistemas, las dos primeras estrofas bajo las notas y el número de página 617 al pie.

caption.en: Carol 741, O holy night, in Carols Old and Carols New (Boston, 1916), page 617: the book our arrangement is read from, with Dwight's first two verses for a soprano or tenor soloist.
caption.es: El villancico 741, O holy night, en Carols Old and Carols New (Boston, 1916), página 617: el libro del que parte nuestro arreglo, con las dos primeras estrofas de Dwight para soprano o tenor solista.

source: Charles L. Hutchins (ed.), Carols Old and Carols New (Boston: The Parish Choir, 1916), Carol 741, "O holy night. ('Noël.')", p. 617 (cropped below the page's decorative headpiece)
